versions.content: The callback function NvM_JobEndNotification is used by the underlying memory abstraction to signal end of job without error. Note: Successful job end notification of the memory abstraction:  Read finished & OK  Write finished & OK  Erase finished & OK This routine might be called in interrupt context, depending on the calling function. All memory abstraction modules should be configured to use the same mode (callback/polling).
